confidence_labels_invariant_note: The frozen v0.20 confidence_label vocabulary is preserved verbatim by v0.32b. Additive fields do NOT change label semantics.

uncertainty_report.resampling_unit_hard_constraint: batch/trajectory only. Row-level bootstrap (flattening spatial or temporal rows as independent observations) is refused with ScopeValidationError; no silent fallback.

calibration_report.builtin_svd_populates_calibration_note: The v0.32b built-in polynomial_translation_svd method does NOT synthesize a calibration report. calibration_report remains None unless a caller supplies an explicit calibration target and method.

strictness_migration.before_v0_32b: summarize_generator_confidence used a permissive _summary_payload handler; nested NaN/Inf could survive.
strictness_migration.after_v0_32b: summarize_generator_confidence routes the fully assembled payload through _validate_strict_json_compatible; NaN/Inf raise SchemaValidationError at the composition boundary. No silent conversion to None.
strictness_migration.backward_compatibility_note: Default calls (no new arguments) produce semantically equivalent output apart from strict rejection of previously invalid NaN/Inf inputs.

non_goals_v0_32b: no reinterpretation of method-native scores as probabilities
no bootstrap intervals called Bayesian posterior intervals
explicit_forbidden_shapes: boolean values inside method_scores (booleans stay booleans in fit_diagnostics/provenance)
NaN or Inf at any nested level of the assembled generator_confidence payload
row-level bootstrap (flattening spatial/temporal rows as independent observations)
silently downgrading a bootstrap to a row bootstrap when too few independent units are available
synthesizing a calibration_report for the built-in SVD method without an explicit calibration target
